# Introduction

Blue jute drapes are a decorative object.
Blue jute drapes can also be found adorning the Dvergr structures built of Black marble throughout the Mistlands. There, they can be broken to obtain their Blue jute, although if a player damages them (or any other structure in range of a Dvergr Ward), nearby Dvergr will become hostile and attack players.
